verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies the en-suite arrangement, shower position, and bathroom and bedroom door locations in the architectural plan.

The client changes the fixture layout by assigning the red-marked location to the toilet and the shower-adjacent yellow location to the washing machine; the former red-area shower location becomes obsolete.
First concrete layout-feasibility failure: the sink and washing machine do not fit under the client's marked en-suite arrangement.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports completing the en-suite plan using an alternative arrangement.
The freelancer substituted an alternative en-suite layout because the client-requested fixture arrangement did not fit, but the client has not accepted that value change.
